Triplet: Fundamental Rights – "guarantees" – civil liberties. Subject_type legal concept, object_type "human right".

Also "includes" – "peaceful assembly". Also "includes" – "freedom to practice religion". Also "includes" – "right to constitutional remedies". Also "right to constitutional remedies" – "exercised by" – writs (list). Could make separate.

Triplet: Fundamental Rights – "defined as" – basic human freedoms. Also "every Indian citizen" – "has right to enjoy" – Fundamental Rights. Could be.
